title: Somewhere in Time
summary: A fisherman hosting a stag do on his boat is found shot with a harpoon.
method: The fisherman was accidentally shot by the harpoon by the viscount (and groom to be). The rest of the group tried to cover it up by placing the boat GPS in a case tied to the buoy. While the rest of the group were taking steps to cover up the murder, the fisherman woke up, so he was suffocated with a blanket. The group then put the body on a dinghy and dropped it off on a nearby beach. They tried to make it look like a drug deal gone wrong by placing the fisherman's burner phone in his pocket but the dinghy wasn't operational.
motive: The killer wanted to fit in with the tight-knit and powerful friend group so he thought this would demonstrate his loyalty.
notes: This is the second-last episode that JP appears regularly, as Selwyn brings up a new opening for head of the police training program.
